name: Moment of Prescience

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

casting_time.trigger: after you fail a D20 Test or an attack hits you

summary: Reaction after your failed D20 Test or an attack hits you: replace your failed roll with 20, or the triggering attacker’s roll with 1.
